name: Gradient-based Sphere Tracing with Lipschitz Constraints
definition: An improvement to sphere tracing that uses the gradient of the Signed Distance Function (SDF) to compute larger, safer step sizes, particularly effective near silhouettes and backward-facing surfaces. It combines the first and second Lipschitz constraints.
summary: Gradient-based Sphere Tracing with Lipschitz Constraints optimizes ray marching by using local SDF gradients and curvature bounds to compute larger, safer step sizes than standard sphere tracing.
